title: The release step runs once: a later choice to turn off sticks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to Yes, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2 (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
  • After the release, have staff member A's Technician switched off and saved, and a later production release deployed since.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's row still shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • Technician is still off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-E4: “The step runs once. A shop that turns Technician off for someone after release keeps it off.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
